A '''ship''' served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] during the [[Second Battle of Obroa-skai]]. Commanded by [[Supreme Commander]] [[Komm Karsh]], it was destroyed and Karsh was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force.<ref name="NJO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>
